static_traits.name: Zhou Peiqi
static_traits.family_status: Lives alone, distant relationship with parents
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues at Work, reduced interaction; lacking close Social support outside Work
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness, no prior counseling/therapy history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression but with doubt and defensiveness; evident self-blame and Anxiety; able to cooperate with counseling; logical thinking but with tendencies to jump to conclusions, mind-read, and catastrophize

basic_info.main_problem: I feel colleagues at the factory no longer talk to me, which has given me Guilt, anxiety and Sense of isolation.
basic_info.core_demands: Because the guilt and isolation at work have begun to affect my overall well-being and mental health, I hope to relieve these troubles through counseling.
growth_experiences: Long-term estrangement from parents in the family of origin and parent-child relationship (specific details Not mentioned), lacking stable emotional support from family.

Adult living situation: Lives alone, lacking an intimate support system to confide in outside Work; this long-term Weak social support may have intensified the experience of isolation when facing setbacks at Work.

core_beliefs: I am incompetent/making a mistake means being negated
Making mistakes will lead others to reject and exclude me

special_situations.event: During breaks or team meetings, colleagues are cold toward her and do not initiate conversation with her
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I ever made a mistake, others will surely think I am incompetent and reject me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces contact with colleagues and stays silent in settings, instead putting energy into doing the work 'perfectly'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They ignore me because of that mistake; they must hate me

special_situations.event: A parts mix-up on the production line caused a process delay
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any mistake will bring serious consequences and collective blame
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles efforts, pursues perfection, improves efficiency to 'make up for the fault'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I caused a major loss; everyone therefore distances themselves from me, and I might even lose my job

special_situations.event: Seeing colleagues chatting with each other but not inviting her to join
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they do not come to me on their own, it means I am not accepted and am superfluous
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively Avoids socializing, reducing eye contact and greetings to avoid embarrassment or Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They exclude me; I am just a person who is not accepted

special_situations.event: Meeting a colleague in the hallway but the other person has not yet greeted first
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not speak to me first, it means they do not like me and always will
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not greeting first, quickly leaving the scene to reduce possible embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: From now on they will all treat me this way; I will always be isolated

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by peers, seen as competent and trustworthy
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being humiliated and rejected for making mistakes, being labeled 'incompetent'
defense_goal: Keeping distance to avoid Being rejected
Gains a sense of safety and control through perfect performance

object_relations.self_representation: An 'incompetent person' who makes mistakes easily and will be rejected

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor raises the inquiry 'could there be other explanations / evidence'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets others' attitudes as blame for one's own faults (projecting inner shame and self-blame onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Repeatedly emphasize in affirmative sentences 'they must be angry at me / hate me', in a firm tone, ignoring counterevidence and uncertainty.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to imagine or try proactively greeting colleagues (behavioral experiment)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing any attempt will immediately meet rejection, so one should not act rashly
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Declines to try with reasons such as 'I need certainty' and 'otherwise it will be terrible', with a cautious tone and repeated weighing.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the emotional experience brought by mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to turn to analyzing process and efficiency to avoid touching shame and the fear of rejection
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Mostly uses facts and process descriptions in place of emotional expression, reduces 'I feel' statements, speech slightly fast.

manifestations: Subjective experience of being snubbed by factory colleagues
Actively avoiding interaction leads to further isolation
Lacks close confidable support outside work

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly blaming oneself: 'they will think I am incompetent'
In sessions, emphasizes 'needing certainty' before daring to act
Being overly cautious about scenarios of possible Being rejected, reducing spontaneity

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to perform an action toward other people or things and instead does it to themselves, directing the energy originally meant to go outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Reduces interaction with colleagues, turns energy toward demanding higher 'perfect performance' of oneself
Staying silent in settings to avoid external conflict

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Interpreting the self-shame experience as 'colleagues hate me / look down on me'
Firmly believing in others' negative evaluations without direct evidence

positive_force: Willing to seek help and try small-step actions (such as greeting first during breaks)
Can notice the lack of direct evidence supporting one's own guesses
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions/mind reading, overgeneralization, and personalization are marked
Avoids socializing to reduce Anxiety in the short term, worsening isolation in the long term
Weak social support system (Living alone, estranged from parents)
Strong need for certainty and Fear of Being rejected

antecedent: Meeting colleagues in hallways and other public areas without yet being greeted first
Thinking about the scene of making mistakes on the production line
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading and catastrophizing (believing others will reject/hate oneself) mutually reinforcing shame, forming Fear of contact
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluation or awkward interaction to temporarily lower Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Deepening isolation at Work, persistent Anxiety and guilt, Decreased appetite and Reduced socializing outside Work

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated self-blame and rumination (constantly replaying mistakes in the mind, believing oneself 'incompetent')
antecedent: When Being alone or after work
When seeing error-related cues at the work site
target_behavior.core_reason: The inner assumption 'mistake = incompetent / will be rejected' driving persistent self-criticism to seek control and prevent errors
target_behavior.function: Trying to prevent recurrence through self-criticism and excessive vigilance, gaining a subjective sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent Anxiety, Decreased appetite, attention occupied, further lowering social and life quality
